OpenFcService.description_en: Activates Function Compute for first-time use by calling this API with identity credentials (such as access keys or temporary security tokens) that have the OpenFcService permission
OpenFcService.description_zh: 首次使用函数计算服务时，您可以使用有OpenFcService权限的身份凭证（如访问密钥、临时安全令牌）通过API开通函数计算
